meet_check: Checked against your rules, IEC 61076, TIA-568 and IPC/WHMA-A-620.

chat.request: Need an M12 A-coded 8-pole cordset to flying leads, 5 m, for a machine with oil and coolant splash. — Dana
chat.question: One question: signal level only, or does any wire carry power? If you don’t know, I’ll assume signal and list it to confirm.

standards_text: Configuration checked against the requirements, with the rule and document behind every line. The connector makers’ ratings certify the parts; the quote proves the assembly matches them.
standards: Current per contact within both connectors’ ratings
Wire size inside the connectors’ range
PUR jacket for oil and coolant splash
Coding and pin count against the device’s socket
Class 3 only if the print calls for it
refusal: D-coded M12 at 10 Gbit/s? Refused: four contacts stop at 100 Mbit/s.
gov_title: Leadership sees how quoting is governed.
golive: Estimators start quoting. Paid only when an order is won.
